segments.title: British battlecruiser costs from Invincible to Hood
segments.summary: Incomplete cost figures prevent a precise chart of how British battlecruiser expenditure rose between HMS Invincible and HMS Hood.
segments.body: Construction costs are not known for every British battlecruiser built between HMS Invincible and HMS Hood. The missing figures rule out a precise ship-by-ship account of how quickly expenditure increased. Known costs still support a rough upward curve across the sequence. Any chart should therefore be read as an approximation rather than a complete cost series.
segments.question: Can the cost growth of British battlecruisers between HMS Invincible and HMS Hood be tracked?
segments.answerShort: Only approximately. Costs rise overall, but missing figures for the ships between Invincible and Hood prevent a precise chart.

evidence.note: Dr. Clarke says the intervening ship costs are not all known, although they can be represented approximately as a rising curve.
